authorization: Owner requested audited obsolete content archival, migration and deletion during execution
consumer_audit: Exact directory and both filenames searched across all tracked files. Matches only historical reports and legacy inventory; no tests, build scripts, CI or current runtime consumer.
process_scan: UNVERIFIED: CIM access denied; failed enumeration is not zero matches
verification: Before/after full SHA256 and byte counts match; historical Git blobs remain recoverable; no installer executed
historical_documents: Preserved unchanged; packaging README redirects old references to this receipt
rollback: Copy both exact archived files back to packaging/release-0.5.0 and verify listed SHA256, or restore these two paths from source_commit. Do not install them.
boundaries: No Git history rewrite or garbage collection
No unknown directories or user data deletion
